segments.text: I cleared storage and got a refund — why does the block still count the full gas?
On Glamsterdam the refund stays on your bill. The block keeps the charge from before that refund.
Clear a slot. You pay less. The block still counts the full charge.
Now the two numbers match. The refund shrinks the block too.
Back on Glamsterdam. Rewrite the slot. Nothing is cleared, so the bill and the block agree.
Put the original value back. That cheaper work still counts for the block. The extra refund comes off your bill only.
A clear splits the numbers on Glamsterdam. Fusaka keeps them together. A rewrite matches on both.
Read the rule on Forkcast. Compare the two numbers on feelyourprotocol dot org.
